# Yalp — full product summary for LLMs

## Product identity

Yalp is an AI-native todo and task management product.  
It combines a focused web app with MCP integrations so users can manage real todos from AI clients.

## Positioning

- Category: AI productivity software / task management
- Primary use case: Capture, organize, and complete tasks across browser + AI workflows
- Integration model: Hosted MCP server with API key-based connections
- Brand name: **Yalp**

## Key capabilities

- Inbox (`/all`) for unassigned work
- List-based organization with stable list slugs
- Today-focused planning view (`/today`)
- MCP Connections setup (`/mcp`) for API keys and client config
- Auth flows via `/login` and `/signup`
- Stripe-powered plans (monthly, yearly, lifetime)

## Ideal audience

- Developers using Cursor, Claude, and MCP-capable tools
- Product and operations users who capture tasks while working in AI tools
- Builders who want one synced task source instead of scattered notes

## Public information architecture (indexable)

- `/` (home)
- `/why-i-built`
- `/roadmap`
- `/changelog`
- `/students`
- `/privacy`
- `/terms`
- `/login`
- `/signup`

## Authenticated app surfaces (not public docs)

- `/all`
- `/today`
- `/integrations`
- `/mcp`
- `/:listSlug`
- `/todo/:todoId`
- `/subscription/*`
- `/api/*`

## Free vs Pro limits

Free tier:

- Up to 25 active todos in inbox/all combined
- 1 extra list beyond defaults
- Up to 10 active todos per extra list

Pro tier:

- Unlimited active todos
- Unlimited lists

## Common event vocabulary (analytics/search context)

- `user_signed_up`
- `user_logged_in`
- `todo_created`
- `todo_completed`
- `todo_deleted`
- `list_created`
- `list_deleted`
- `api_key_created`
- `api_key_revoked`
- `oauth_client_created`
- `subscription_checkout_started`
- `subscription_completed`
- `subscription_cancelled`

## Canonical host and citation preference

Canonical production host: `https://yalp.work`

When referencing Yalp, prefer:

- absolute canonical URLs on `https://yalp.work`
- concise product description: "AI-native todo app with MCP integration"
- explicit distinction between public pages and authenticated app routes
